The '''Strabin sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
The sector was terrorized by the [[Exelis Hunters]] until they were stopped by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Arcuse]] some time before [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
